purpose: One control per promise the employee makes. Promotion requires every control; there is no averaging.

cases.requirement: Published contracts are current, identified and honest.
Valid assignments become proposals; invalid ones are rejected without work.
The PEG/1 wire attests assignments, refuses defects with typed documents, and HTTP equals in-process.
English live surface, no machine paths, vendored protocol schemas, honest command-line exit codes.
One version everywhere; gate corpora name real tests.
